confidence.formula: combined = 0.6 × dataConfidence + 0.4 × modelConfidence, then multiplied by each cap factor (ADEQUACY_PARTIAL 0.85, ADEQUACY_INSUFFICIENT 0.6, STALE_DATA 0.9, DILUTION_PROXY 0.98, DIVIDEND_SOURCE_CONFLICT 0.95, HIGH_METHOD_DISAGREEMENT 0.85), rounded to 4 dp; R-4.3 policy-default penalties apply additively by assumption category (POLICY_DEFAULT_WACC 0.2 + POLICY_DEFAULT_MULTIPLE 0.15) and are capped at one aggregate reduction of 0.35 — applied once here, 0.35, so ×0.65, with no minimum-confidence floor

limitations: Dilutive potential shares (ESOP, convertibles) are not present in dataset schema v1, so the diluted count is the EPS-implied count and carries the DILUTION_PROXY cap.

Net debt subtracts cash and cash equivalents plus liquid investments only; restricted balances, margin money and regulatory balances are excluded from available cash by construction (R-4.1 / Schedule III). Dataset schema v1 carries no restricted-balance line item, so the component is published as NOT_COMPUTABLE rather than as a zero.
The corporate-action table carries no dividend declaration record in dataset schema v1, so R-15 corroboration is unavailable for this assessment.

Gross debt counts 3 component(s) that the filer declared nil as zero (shortTermBorrowings, currentMaturities, longTermBorrowings). Each is published as NIL_BY_DISCLOSURE with its filing reference and period, not as a reported zero, and an unreported or unavailable component would still block the aggregate.

Associates/JV carrying value is not recorded in the dataset schema (NOT_COMPUTABLE: NOT_REPORTED), so the enterprise-to-equity bridge substitutes zero for that term under policy associates-treatment/1.0.0. This is a policy substitution, not an issuer-reported nil: equity value is understated by any associates/JV carrying value the issuer reports.

R-4.3's policy-default penalty is applied: the valuation leans on 2 distinct assumption category(ies) (POLICY_DEFAULT_WACC 0.2, POLICY_DEFAULT_MULTIPLE 0.15) triggered by DCF_FCFF/discountRate, PE_RELATIVE/targetMultiple, EV_EBITDA/targetMultiple. The reductions are additive and capped once at 0.35, so the published confidence carries a 0.35 reduction (×0.65); multiple methods sharing one assumption category carry one penalty, and no minimum-confidence floor exists.

The owner must obtain current issuer evidence for the carrying value, or explicitly reconsider the POLICY_ZERO treatment; the flag itself changes no value, no nil and no confidence. A review flag is not a carrying value: no figure has been established, no unavailable input has been converted into a nil, and the flag changes no valuation output.
